source_focus.source_title: Florida AG vows public corruption crackdown after Fort Pierce city manager Nicholas Mimms conviction - WPBF
source_focus.source_lead: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is promising a broader crackdown on public corruption following the conviction of former Fort Pierce City Manager Nicholas Mimms. Lucie County jury found Mimms guilty of official misconduct but acquitted him of bid tampering.
